summary: Phase 10 targeted checks all PASS. Grace replay: 25/25 PASS (incl JRN-135, JRN-136, REQ-318, Q-49) deterministic. Client A page shows 2 Review links (data-testid=attempt-<stream>-review-link) pointing to /review/{attempt_id}. 3D demo review (/review/48461db6-...): header shows Client A (synthetic), 'Review demo route 3D (synthetic) · v1', date, Elapsed 0:32, Checkpoints reached 2 of 3, Help=1, Cues spoken 7 · suppressed 6, '1 routine silences hidden'. review-scene present, canvas rendered, 13 path-dot-<id> buttons (green circles spoken + orange squares suppressed), legend present, alignment note 'Run start aligned to the taught route's entrance.' present. Timeline has 20 items including start/pause/resume/end, checkpoints, spoken cues, 'Would have said:' suppressed items with plain reasons ('Not repeated', 'Held back: another cue 1.5 s earlier', 'Not sure enough (confidence 0.45)', 'Pause message already given', 'Vision check failed'), practitioner message 'Keep the wall on your left.', Vision unavailable, Vision unsure. Filters timeline-filter-all/spoken/suppressed toggle aria-pressed and filter correctly (all=20, spoken=7, suppressed=6). Details button aria-expanded false->true. Linking: clicking a path-dot sets .bv-tl-selected on matching timeline item (confirmed via data-testid); keyboard Enter on focused dot also selects. 'Show on path' on timeline item highlights .bv-dot-selected/.bv-dot-svg-selected. 2D demo review (/review/a59b1526-...): header 'Review demo route 2D (synthetic) · v1', 2 of 2, no 3D canvas, review-path-2d SVG with 13 cue dots, bidirectional linking verified. Error states: /review/nope -> 'Attempt not found' (attempt-review-error); ephemeral not_started attempt -> 'This attempt hasn't started yet.'; ephemeral started+ended with no frames -> review-no-path 'No path recorded for this attempt.' All 3 ephemeral attempts (plus their events) deleted via motor using MONGO_URL/DB_NAME; demo attempts preserved. Q-46 header-vs-events parity: 0 mismatches on both demos (spoken/suppressed/routine_hidden/checkpoints_reached/help_count all equal). Q-47: timeline-list visible in <0.1s (well under 3s). Mobile 390px: 3D canvas renders, 13 dots, no horizontal overflow, header/body stack correctly. Run API /api/run/{demo_id} returns 401 without key; RunInfo and CuesOut models in backend/run.py contain no trail/pose/review fields (only attempt_id, stream_id, goal, checkpoints, stop_rule, last_cue, state / cues+state).
critical_code_review_comments: review.py: /review response splits into header/timeline/path cleanly; routine_hidden computed server-side so UI header matches event-log counts (Q-46 verified 0 mismatches).
cue_policy.py grace: first_frame_at + GRACE_S=15 correctly suppresses no-frames pause both at start and after resume; replay includes JRN-135/136, REQ-318 and Q-49 phone-camera case.
Path2D dead-reckoning note 'about 0.7 m per step' is shown; aligned-note shown only for 3D (good).
TimelineItem exposes stable data-testids (timeline-item-<id>, ...-show-button, ...-details-button, ...-details, ...-reason) which made linking tests trivial and robust.
Suppressed items use plain-word reasons (REQ-339) and 'Would have said: ...' prefix (REQ-334) exactly as spec.
